checks.title: Confirm sales goal and owner
checks.instructions: Record the named lead owner, offer, target buyer and market, intended useful meeting, excluded actions, and first review outcome.

checks.title: Verify the inbound source
checks.instructions: Identify an authorized form, inbox, CRM, or export; account, live/test scope, fields, time coverage, freshness, duplicate IDs, and prior-contact visibility. A file is enough for a manual first result.

checks.title: Agree on fit, contact policy, and metric
checks.instructions: Record qualification and routing criteria, suppression/opt-out checks, allowed channels, approval owner, useful-meeting definition and source, and actual baseline or baseline-first decision. Do not invent consent or a conversion rate.

checks.title: Bind two ready Crews
checks.instructions: Record distinct authorized Crew IDs with lead-intake-qualifier and sales-followup-coordinator selected skills and verified setup. Add account-researcher only if needed, with its own access and setup evidence.

checks.title: Test source and policy access
checks.instructions: Read one representative authorized inbound record in Qualification and the approved offer/contact history needed by Follow-up. Record what cannot be checked without CRM or inbox access; never copy credentials across Crews.

checks.title: Validate every selected handoff
checks.instructions: Run the bundled deterministic validator on real lead-qualification-brief/v1 with --require-ready before any consumer, then sales-followup-draft/v1; if Research is included, validate account-research-brief/v1 and its link to the lead. Save run IDs, paths and results, and prove invalid and blocked lead fixtures stop the consumer.

checks.title: Review the Automation plan
checks.instructions: Show actual Crew IDs, bounded fields and source access, validator steps, cost/budget, draft approval point, contact and CRM write boundaries, and manual activation state to the owner.

checks.title: Run the first route manually
checks.instructions: Record one bounded run on a real authorized inbound lead, with Crew run IDs, artifact paths, validator results, reviewable draft or internal disposition, and explicit blockers. A fictional fixture alone does not complete this check.

checks.title: Track reviewed next action
checks.instructions: Record stable lead/action IDs, owner, draft versus approved/sent state, source links, suppression check, current reply or meeting state, and next-check date. Re-read state before any later contact; prevent duplicate sends.

checks.title: Choose run policy
checks.instructions: Record manual-only or a reviewed paused authenticated event/schedule with timezone, concurrency, retries, budget, notifications, and duplicate handling. Completion does not enable recurrence or sending.
